name: Pyramid Head
description: An executioner born from guilt and suffering, wielding ancient judgment powers. His presence marks survivors with the Mark of Torment.

name: Nemesis
description: A bioweapon of terrible power, relentlessly pursuing its prey with superhuman strength and resilience.

name: Albert Wesker
description: A brilliant scientist turned monster, wielding superhuman abilities and tactical intelligence.

name: Michael Myers
description: The Shape. An unstoppable killer driven by pure evil, growing stronger as he takes victims.

name: Freddy Krueger
description: A dream demon who pulls survivors into the nightmare realm where he reigns supreme.

name: The Spirit
description: A vengeful spirit torn between worlds, capable of phasing through reality itself.

name: The Blight
description: A corrupted scientist enhanced by his own serum, capable of swift, erratic movement.

name: The Wraith
description: A former vigilante who has learned to hide in plain sight, becoming nearly invisible.

name: The Hillbilly
description: A deformed killer who has embraced a tool of destruction as his instrument of death.

name: The Nurse
description: A deranged nurse with the ability to blink between locations, appearing anywhere she wishes.

name: The Oni
description: A demon of vengeance and rage, growing stronger as he hunts survivors.

name: Victor
description: Conjoined twins with horrifying origins, able to separate and attack from unexpected angles.

name: The Deathslinger
description: A gunslinger who has adapted his harpoon gun for a new kind of hunt.

name: The Trapper
description: A hunter turned killer, using elaborate traps to ensnare his prey.

name: The Plague
description: A corrupted priestess who spreads pestilence and sickness wherever she goes.
